plugins.name: dev-orchestrator
plugins.description: Multi-phase development workflow orchestrator with persistent state management. Speed, efficiency, and one-shot autonomous execution modes. Token-efficiency design with cost-metric observability.

plugins.name: rpi-bugfix
plugins.description: Gated Research→Plan→Implement workflow taking a single bug from a Jira key to a verified PR. Thin orchestrator delegating diagnosis (debug-error/bugsnag-triage methodology) and PR steps (self-review/pr-ci-fixer); three hard human gates; per-phase pinned models; code-graph impact validation; resumable state. Optional rapid-iteration mode (per-phase skill-improvement feedback loop with abort→implement→rewind) and a high/medium/low intensity dial. Requires the bugsnag-triage plugin.
